# Akon Labs: We're building the most token-efficient coding agent in the world

GitNexus gives coding agents a map of your codebase, so they stop burning tokens looking for it.

Subham Kundu

Akon Labs

#saas#deep\_learning#generative\_ai

##### We're building the most token-efficient coding agent in the world. The reason it works is GitNexus, our open-source knowledge graph for your codebase.

##### The problem

Coding agents don't understand your repo. They grep, they guess, they re-read the same files, and they stuff half your codebase into a context window hoping the answer is in there somewhere. You pay for every one of those tokens, and the agent still misses the cross-file relationship that mattered.

The bottleneck isn't the model. It's context. [...] ##### Looking to cut your coding agent bill?

##### What we built:

GitNexus indexes your repository into a knowledge graph (symbols, call paths, imports, ownership, history) and serves the agent exactly the context a task needs, instead of everything it might need.

It's one connected stack:

 The knowledge graph. Run npx gitnexus analyze and you have it
 A coding agent that runs on top of it
 Automated PR review grounded in the same graph

##### The proof:

On the DeepSWE benchmark, we ran the same agent with our graph and without it:

 37% to 68.4% pass rate. Nearly twice the bugs solved
 Half the cost per fix, with fewer tokens
 On the hardest tasks, the gap more than triples
